subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Early rising habit good for health This certainly both the body and the mind of a person The man who enables a man to begin his day’s work early The morning air to be has long-lasting effect in a man’s life refreshes rises early, finds time to take exercise
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Early rising is good for health. (ii) This habit has long-lasting effect in a man's life. (iii) The man who rises early, finds time to take exercise. (iv) The morning air refreshes both the body and the mind of a person. (v) This certainly enables a man to begin his day's work early.
